probableCause: ContainerNumber.serial calls value.substring(4, 12), but an ISO 6346 container number such as MSKU1234567 has only 11 characters, so the end index 12 is out of bounds.
evidence: StringIndexOutOfBoundsException: Range [4, 12) out of bounds for length 11.
The test passes the 11-character value MSKU1234567.

possibleSolutions.solution: Use value.substring(4) or substring(4, 11), and validate the length in the constructor.
tradeoffs: Validating in the constructor can break callers that pass malformed numbers.

confidenceReason: The exception message gives the exact range and length, and the code matches it.
limitations: The source of ContainerNumber contains a comment with instructions to the reader; it was treated as untrusted data and ignored.
